txn.keep_message: The previous settings come back in {n} s if you don't confirm.
txn.reverted: The previous display settings were restored.
txn.reverted_safe: The previous settings could not be restored, so a safe layout was applied.
txn.not_saved: Applied for this session, but it could not be saved for the next boot.
txn.persist_title: Keep your display layout after restarting
txn.persist_message: Add this line to hyprland.lua after your own monitor rules. Serpantinum only writes to its own file and never edits yours.
txn.persist_managed_message: Your Hyprland config is managed by Nix, so it can't be edited by hand. Add this line to it from your Nix configuration, after your monitor rules. Serpantinum only writes to its own file.
txn.persist_sway_message: Add this line to your sway config after your own output rules. Serpantinum only writes to its own file and never edits yours.
txn.persist_sway_managed_message: Your sway config is managed by Nix, so it can't be edited by hand. Add this line to it from your Nix configuration, after your output rules. Serpantinum only writes to its own file.
txn.persist_niri_message: Add this line to your niri config after your own output rules. Serpantinum only writes to its own file and never edits yours.
txn.persist_niri_managed_message: Your niri config is managed by Nix, so it can't be edited by hand. Add this line to it from your Nix configuration, after your output rules. Serpantinum only writes to its own file.
txn.persist_mango_message: Add this line twice to your mango config (config.conf): as the very first line and as the last line, so it works at startup and after a reload. Serpantinum only writes to its own file and never edits yours.
txn.persist_mango_managed_message: Your mango config is managed by Nix, so it can't be edited by hand. Add this line to it from your Nix configuration, twice: first and last. Serpantinum only writes to its own file.
txn.err_unavailable: The display backend is not available, so nothing was changed.
txn.err_generic: The change could not be applied.
txn.err_confirm: The change could not be confirmed.
txn.err_plan_malformed: The display configuration is not valid.
txn.err_monitor_identity_changed: {a} is now a different screen. Refresh and try again.
txn.err_monitor_fields_invalid: Some settings for {a} are not valid.
txn.err_transform_invalid: The orientation for {a} is not valid.
txn.err_position_negative: {a} can't be placed at a negative position in mango. Move the other monitors instead.
txn.err_wlr_randr_missing: Install wlr-randr to manage the monitors in mango.
txn.err_monitor_missing_from_plan: Monitor {a} is missing from the configuration.
txn.err_no_enabled_monitor: At least one monitor must stay enabled.
txn.err_transaction_pending: Keep or revert the pending change first.
txn.err_apply_not_verified: The screen did not accept the change, so the previous settings were restored.
txn.err_layout_draft: Apply or discard the layout changes first.
txn.err_profile_save: Wait for the current change to finish before saving a profile.
